custodyProfile.uncertainty: Whole-book custody is mixed: the immediate vault and Morpho lender positions are on-chain, while pathUSD depends on Bridge-reported cash and Treasury reserves and cbBTC depends on Coinbase-held BTC. At Tempo block 44247051 (2026-10-15T10:43:13Z), idle assets were 36668441836389 raw pathUSD and the sole lending position 180266970247 raw. These are immediate allocation amounts, not custody-provider percentages. No exact-share legal insolvency priority or whole-book collateral-custody safeguards were established. Lending reuse is explicit. Sentora's June 2026 terms section 4.3 describes non-custodial configurations and section 21.4 specifies BVI law and arbitration; these legal statements do not remove observed curator powers or prove upstream segregation. Lending deployment is intentional strategy reuse; it does not establish custodians' contractual rights to repledge collateral, which remain unknown.
